observations.recommendedUse: Use as the first owned visibility benchmark across Search, YouTube, and Play placements.
observations.summary: Google Ads Transparency Center shows verified advertiser Remit2Any Inc in the United States with 57 public ads. Placement filters show 32 Google Search ads, 45 YouTube ads, 4 Google Play ads, and 0 Google Maps or Shopping ads. Placement counts overlap and should not be summed.
observations.title: Owned brand has visible Google ad footprint

The same query also returns unrelated expat-travel rows, so Xpat-specific filtering is required before analysis.
observations.title: Xpat event ads are visible on Meta

data.summary: Xpat has visible public ad-library presence, including Telugu community event sponsorships. Use this as a dated footprint benchmark only.
